svg.title: Profiles of six domains on the dimensions that shape their roadmaps
svg.desc: A grid of six domains against five dimensions, each rated from low to high. Medicine is high on regulation, cumulative structure and tacit share. Software is low on regulation and high on rate of change. Languages are unregulated and slow to change. Trades are regulated, tacit-heavy and give fast feedback. Management is unregulated, weakly cumulative, tacit-heavy and gives slow feedback. Ratings are broad judgements.
svg.text: Domain profiles: why roadmaps differ in shape
Broad, illustrative judgements; individual roles within a domain vary.
